title: scATAC-seq (combinatorial indexing)
scope: Cusanovich 2015 combinatorial indexing scATAC-seq implementation represented by the assigned Illumina cell-index schematic; not the microfluidic implementation. The three drawn first-round wells and three drawn second-round wells are illustrative independently routed populations. The endpoint is a pooled indexed DNA library. The left single-cell/chromatin cartoon explains the biological target rather than adding a separate material-processing route.

method_scopes.rationale: The assigned title, catalogue description, visible two rounds of well indexing, and Cusanovich Fig. 1A establish this implementation. All eleven local operation instances apply: isolate nuclei; split to first wells; tag each of the three depicted wells separately; pool and dilute intact tagged nuclei; split to second wells; PCR-barcode each of the three depicted wells separately; pool DNA products. The primary text clarifies that nuclei remain intact during pooling/redistribution, followed by nuclear lysis and indexed PCR within each second well. These clarifications fit the drawn order. The left explanatory chromatin inset is not connected as an additional branch. The colors depict index distinctions without specifying sequences or chemical end groups. The image ends at physical DNA; sequencing and downstream interpretation are explained prospectively from the paper, without adding unshown operations. The paper describes many wells; the three shown per round are not literal experimental counts.
